actions.name: ethereal sight
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane.

actions.name: incorporeal movement
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can move through other creatures and objects as if they were &Reference[Difficult Terrain]. It takes [[/damage 1d10 average type=force]] damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: etherealness
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplEtherealne]{Etherealness} spell, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is visible on the Material Plane while on the Border Ethereal and vice versa, but it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

actions.name: horrific visage
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=v8KiqUloIE5eocSu]], each creature in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=v8KiqUloIE5eocSu]]-foot Cone that can see the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} and isn't an Undead. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Frightened apply=false] condition until the start of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn. Success: The target is immune to this [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s Horrifying Visage for 24 hours.

actions.name: possession
actions.desc: Charisma Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=7gmNBVjwuYTyANMe]], one [[lookup @target.affects.special activity=7gmNBVjwuYTyANMe]] the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=7gmNBVjwuYTyANMe]] feet. Failure: The target is possessed by the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}; the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} disappears, and the target has the &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] condition and loses control of its body. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} now controls the body, but the target retains awareness. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that specifically target Undead. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s game statistics are the same, except it uses the possessed target's Speed, as well as the target's Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution modifiers. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 Hit Points or the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} leaves as a Bonus Action. When the possession ends, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target, and the target is immune to this ghost's Possession for 24 hours. Success: The target is immune to this [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s Possession for 24 hours.
